DIA.35g6 En-8(D) BRIGHT BAR."},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS,HARDNESS 850."}],"comment":"The shaft diameter is specified as a g6 fit (N1) and the part receives 15–20 µm of hard chrome plating (N4), but no allowance is made for the plating thickness on this tight fit. The added plating will push the finished diameter out of the g6 tolerance band, preventing proper assembly with mating parts. The designer should either reduce the pre-plate machining size by the plating thickness or add a note to grind after plating to the final g6 dimension.","recommended_correction":"Reduce the pre-plate diameter by the plating thickness or specify grinding to the final g6 size after plating."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"4) $FLASH HARD CHROME PLATING 15 TO 20 MICRONS,HARDNESS 850."}],"comment":"A hardness value of 850 is stated in the surface treatment note (N4) without specifying whether it applies before or after plating, nor what scale is used (e.g., HV). Without a defined stage and scale, manufacturing and inspection cannot verify the requirement, risking an incorrect heat-treatment sequence or acceptance of a non-conforming part. The designer should state the hardness scale and clarify whether the hardness applies before or after the chrome plating.","recommended_correction":"Specify the hardness scale (e.g., 850 HV) and state whether the hardness requirement applies before or after plating."}]}
